data.job_title: Mechanical Engineer Industrial Systems & Physical Automation
data.additional_information:
THE ROLE
Fluxion operates in environments where mechanical failure costs crore of rupees per hour: port terminal equipment at Kandla,
steel plant material handling systems, automated guided vehicle fleets, and EV manufacturing assembly lines. The mechanical
engineer we are hiring will be working at the interface between these physical systems and the digital intelligence we are deploying
on top of them.
This is not a design office role. You will be on site. You will be assessing real plant, specifying real components, and working
alongside electronics and systems engineers to make automated systems function in the physical world. If your ideal engineering
career involves staying at a desk, this is not the right position.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Condition assessment of mechanical plant at port, steel, and manufacturing sites: conveyors, cranes, reach stackers, AGV
infrastructure, and material handling equipment
– Specification and procurement of components for automation retrofits: drive systems, structural modifications, and motion control
hardware
– Failure mode and effects analysis for rotating and lifting equipment, informing where sensors are placed and what predictive
maintenance models need to monitor
– Site oversight of mechanical works at demo installations and pilot deployments, coordinating with contractors and site teams
– Electromechanical integration work alongside electronics engineers: motor control, actuator selection, and load analysis for
automated systems
– Vendor assessment for AGV manufacturers, conveyor OEMs, and automation equipment suppliers
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in mechanical engineering from a recognised institution
– Sound grounding in core mechanical principles: stress analysis, machine design, dynamics, and thermal systems
– Comfort with engineering drawings, P&IDs, and equipment specifications — you should be able to read them, not just produce
them
– Any hands-on experience with industrial equipment, workshop practice, or real physical systems, whether through internship,
project, or personal interest
– Willingness to spend significant time on industrial sites across India; site work is a large part of this role
– Exposure to automation, robotics, or mechatronics through coursework or projects is a meaningful advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.
